_comment: PROPOSED shapes awaiting review — not live until merged into neighborhood_shapes.py. Open the editor to review, adjust, or discard: python neighborhoods/edit_neighborhoods.py

properties.name: Hayes Valley
properties.note: Golden Gate Ave (N) to Market (S), Van Ness (E) to Webster (W). Overlaps the east edge of Duboce.

properties.name: Lower Haight
properties.note: Haight St corridor, Divisadero to Webster, Oak (N) to Duboce (S). Sits inside the existing Duboce shape.

properties.name: Panhandle
properties.note: The park strip plus a block either side — Stanyan to Baker, Grove (N) to Page (S). Overlaps NOPA/USF zone and Haight/Cole Valley.

properties.name: Noe Valley
properties.note: 24th St corridor — 21st (N) to 30th (S), Grand View (W) to Dolores (E). Sits inside the existing Castro/Noe shape.
